seedTasks.title: Call the bank about the card

_notes.name: The board's title, shown at the top, such as "Dana's week".
_notes.weekStart: "mon" or "sun": the day the first column shows.
_notes.columns: 7 shows every day; 5 shows Monday to Friday.
_notes.later: true shows the Later rail for things with no day yet; false hides it.
_notes.seedTasks: The cards the board starts with on its first open, each a title and a day: mon to sun, today, tomorrow, or later. A card on a day already past this week, and still open, carries into today with a "from Mon" badge. Use [] for an empty board.
_notes.theme: graphite (dark, cool blue), linen (light warm paper, ink blue), forest (deep green, amber), or auto (linen by day, graphite when the device is set to dark).
